title: Orchard and Vow Anew
author: Silas Yarrow
blurb: Rafael Nystrom, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
